dsh-projection-guard 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。会话投影缓存守卫：逐行 JSON 降级，单个违规投影单元（如第三方插件存储 Map）不再拖垮会话标题与整个缓存；启动自愈自动补全缺失标题。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-85a8b3d7488395ad77c7.html
posts.en:
dsh-projection-guard is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Guards the persisted session-projection cache: per-row JSON degradation so one misbehaving projection unit (e.g. a third-party plugin storing a Map) can never stall session titles or the whole cache again, plus a startup self-heal that backfills missing titles.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-85a8b3d7488395ad77c7.html
